policies: All eleven canonical upgraded Hero Power faces are necessary Standard dependencies of CATA_615t. They are noncollectible dependencies, not new Standard candidate roots. Genn hand transformation and its upgrade/cost battlecry remain pending.

Each native body composes the ordinary Hero Power activation, damage/healing kind, armor/attack, draw, equipment, physical summon and choice pipeline. Printed cost remains original (Demon Hunter one, other classes two); Genn cost changes are not fabricated in these definitions.

Upgraded Totemic Slam offers all four canonical basic Totems and permits a duplicate current Totem; no ordinary discovery fact. Paladin issues two fixed original recruit requests. Upgraded Ghoul uses the source child owner-end death body. Board requirements share the existing admission rule.

Primary gallery omits only the pinned Paladin live stat placeholder and Hunter alternate-body delimiter; both complete raw bodies and all numbers remain. Three exact IDs return HTTP200 empty in both languages; the six full responses are preserved in primary-observations-04.json. Their client rows and DK child identity/owner-end policy are internally pinned, not primary-confirmed.
Class-specific basic upgrading/alias rules, duplicate Totem permission, DK child identity/turn window and exact CN semantics remain M6 policies; no formal pool or complete Genn support claim.
